name: Coordinated Maneuvers
benefit:
Whenever you are adjacent to an ally who also has this feat, you receive a +2 competence bonus on all combat maneuver checks. This bonus increases to +4 when attempting to break free from a grapple.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 116
When you attempt a combat maneuver while adjacent to an ally who also has this feat, you can spend 1 stamina point to increase your bonus from this feat on that combat maneuver check by 2.
flavor: You are skilled at working with your allies to perform dangerous combat maneuvers.
